_readme: Supplier page details for Smart Farming News, gathered 17 Nov 2026 from each company's own website (title, meta description, header logo). Where the site gave no usable logo, the logo is from the company's Wikimedia Commons file. dark:true means the logo is white and is shown on a dark tile. An empty website or logo means we could not confirm one: leave it empty rather than guess. Sector drives the filter on the hub.

Alpego.line: Italian maker of agricultural machinery, including drills.

Atmonia.line: Company developing compact ammonia production for fertiliser.

Avon Tuning HD.line: ECU remapping for heavy duty, agricultural and forestry machines.

Bayer.line: Crop protection products and agronomy support from Bayer Crop Science UK.

Berrys.line: Property consultancy and land agent covering rural and farm property.

Cargill.line: Food, agriculture and animal nutrition company.

Claas.line: Maker of tractors, combine harvesters, forage harvesters, telehandlers and balers.

Ecorobotix.line: Maker of AI-driven precision field sprayers.

Feather Down Farms.line: Farm stay holidays run on working UK farms.

Fendt.line: Agricultural machinery brand owned by AGCO.

G.T. Bunning & Sons.line: Maker of rear discharge muck spreaders.

Kilter.line: Maker of the AX-1, an autonomous robot that spot-sprays weeds in vegetable fields.

Kubota.line: Maker of agricultural, groundcare and construction machinery and engines.

KUHN.line: Maker of machinery for hay and silage, baling, bedding, seeding and spraying.

Massey Ferguson.line: Tractor and agricultural machinery brand owned by AGCO.

NFU Mutual.line: Farm, home and business insurer and pensions provider with UK agencies.

OlsAro.line: Seed genetics company developing climate-resilient cereals.

OPTYGAZ.line: Fuel technology company claiming lower butane use on irrigation engines.

PerPlant.line: AI camera system that lets tractors see individual plants.

Pitchup.line: Online booking site for campsites and glamping.

PTx.line: AGCO's precision farming business, combining PTx Trimble and Precision Planting.

SatYield.line: Satellite crop yield data for agricultural and commodity markets.

Seederal.line: French company designing an electric farm tractor.

Switch Bioworks.line: Engineers soil microbes that produce nitrogen fertiliser.

Vogelsang.line: Engineering company making equipment for agriculture, biogas and wastewater.

Volare.line: Producer of black soldier fly protein, oil and fertiliser from food sidestreams.
